title: Welcome to Claudeforce.
summary: Claudeforce unites the #1 AI, Anthropic's Claude, with the #1 CRM, Salesforce — trusted data, workflows & governance right inside Claude, with Salesforce in Claude for revenue teams.
body_markdown:
###


Claudeforce is the partnership between[Salesforce](https://salesforce.com/) and[Anthropic](https://www.anthropic.com/) that brings the #1 AI — Anthropic's Claude — together with the #1 AI CRM, Salesforce. It puts your trusted business data, workflows, and governance to work inside the leading AI model, so the most capable[AI](https://www.salesforce.com/artificial-intelligence/) can reason over the truth of your business and take action on it. The first product of the partnership is Salesforce in Claude, focused on the sales/revenue persona — bringing that team's data and workflows into Claude first.


###


Salesforce and Anthropic have been building together for some time — Claude Tag in[Slack](https://www.salesforce.com/slack/) ,[Agentforce](https://www.salesforce.com/agentforce/) for financial services and healthcare, and MCP integrations across the platform. Claudeforce brings that work together into one partnership: combining Claude's frontier intelligence with the trusted data, applications, workflows, and governance businesses rely on. Read the latest in the[Salesforce Newsroom](https://www.salesforce.com/news/) .


###


Salesforce in Claude is the first product to come out of the Claudeforce partnership. It's a plugin that gives sellers and their agents 37 pre-built skills — so they can reason over live revenue data, keep pipeline updated automatically, and take action, all without leaving Claude, governed by the same rules Salesforce already runs on.


###


Through[Headless 360](https://www.salesforce.com/headless/) — Salesforce's architecture that exposes the full[platform](https://www.salesforce.com/platform/) (data, workflows, business logic, and permissions) as capabilities AI can access directly through a secure MCP (Model Context Protocol) connection, with no custom integration work. It grounds Claude in the deterministic truth of your business, so you get the same data, context, and answer whether you're in Salesforce Lightning, Slack, or Claude. Access is governed and managed at scale with[MuleSoft](https://www.salesforce.com/mulesoft) .


###


Yes —[Slack](https://slack.com/) is where people and agents work together. Claude serves as the intelligent backbone across Slack, powering personal productivity through Slackbot, augmenting team decisions through Claude Tag, and accelerating multiplayer coding as a founding partner for[Slack Code](https://slack.com/features/code-channels/) . That means you can reason through complex decisions alongside Claude in Slack, then instantly execute governed, high-value actions in Salesforce — all without leaving your workflow.


###


Trust is built into the architecture, not bolted on. Every answer and every action runs through your existing Salesforce permissions and business rules — Claude sees only what a given user is authorized to see, and can only do what that user is authorized to do. There's no new permissions model to stand up: an admin simply connects Salesforce in Claude, and it works for the whole team from day one, with nothing to re-audit or configure account by account. You control how much autonomy Claude has on the write side and when it updates inside Salesforce.


###


Claude works with the deterministic truth of your business — the customer data, pipeline, workflows, business logic, and permissions Salesforce has always delivered — unified through[Data 360](https://www.salesforce.com/data/) and exposed through Headless 360. Grounding Claude's probabilistic intelligence in that trusted context is what makes its answers reliable, instead of "probably" right.


###


Salesforce in Claude is launching with the Sales use case first, shipping more soon. It's available to select pilot customers today, with plans for an open beta starting in September. The initial release comes with prebuilt skills for Sales, and we'll add more for other teams over the next few months. Salesforce is its own Customer Zero — already using it against real pipeline, real accounts, and real deals. Stay updated to find out when beta opens, and come see Claudeforce live at[Dreamforce](https://www.salesforce.com/dreamforce/) .
